home.title: MOBILUX | The hotel that moves for you
home.description: MOBILUX combines transport, accommodation and experiences in a single journey across Europe. Explore the City and Nature itineraries.

hero.eyebrow: A new way to discover Europe
hero.title: The hotel that moves for you.
hero.text: Discover Europe differently, with the comfort of a hotel that travels with you from one destination to the next.

concept.title: Why stay in one place when your hotel can take you everywhere?
concept.intro: MOBILUX brings transport, accommodation, tourism and tailored experiences together in one carefully planned journey across Europe.
concept.f1_text: Choose the pick-up option that suits you and tell us where you would like to board.
concept.f2_text: Set routes that connect some of Europe's most remarkable destinations.
concept.f3_text: If you wish, add food experiences, guided tours, wellness and concierge services.

night.title: You sleep. We move.
night.text: On selected overnight routes, you can rest while the journey continues to the next destination. Overnight travel would always be planned around a professional crew, driver rest periods and the applicable safety regulations.

journey.title: Your whole journey in one place
journey.text: My Journey shows your demonstration booking and the details of your trip.

fleet.title: A hotel suite that travels with you
fleet.intro: This is how we imagine the MOBILUX coach, from the first drawing to the interior.
fleet.alt: The MOBILUX coach at sunset, with a line of LED light along the bodywork
fleet.step1_text: It all starts with a drawing: 11.5 metres long and 2.55 metres wide, planned around a complete suite.
fleet.step2_text: Soft lines and large tinted windows keep the landscape in view and your privacy intact.
fleet.step3_text: A line of LED light follows the profile of the coach, so it is easy to recognise even at night.
fleet.step4_text: Inside, about 28 m² with a double bedroom, a living area, a fitted kitchen and a bathroom with shower.
fleet.plan_alt: Top view floor plan of the suite: bedroom, living area, kitchen and bathroom

city.description: Explore Europe's most iconic cities through their art, architecture, gastronomy and culture.

nature.description: Discover Europe's finest natural destinations through wellness, landscapes and exclusive outdoor experiences.

package.title: {name}: the itinerary
package.itinerary_intro: Every stop leaves time for local culture, gastronomy and experiences worth remembering.
package.note: Illustrative itinerary prepared for an academic presentation. Travel times, operating stops and activity availability are subject to planning.

service.Premium food and beverage service: Premium food and drink on board
